## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes locally (lint, typecheck, test, build)
- [ ] No bare numbers: every model output shows its band, its source and whether it is observed or simulated
- [ ] Scenarios are compared, never ranked or labelled "recommended"
- [ ] Warnings describe, they do not prescribe

### Blog posts (skip if none)

- [ ] Every number in the prose has a citation (footnote or `sources:` entry)
- [ ] Interactive widgets show band, provenance and an "illustrative" label
- [ ] Machine translations carry `translatedBy: machine` and `translationOf`
- [ ] `draft: true` removed only when the post is ready to publish
